description: This file contains Sass mixin definitions for rendering caret icons in different directions, used for styling purposes in a CSS preprocessor context.

methods.name: caret-down
methods.description: Creates a downward pointing caret using CSS borders.

methods.name: caret-up
methods.description: Creates an upward pointing caret using CSS borders.

methods.name: caret-end
methods.description: Creates a caret pointing to the end (right side).

methods.name: caret-start
methods.description: Creates a caret pointing to the start (left side).

methods.name: caret
methods.description: Main mixin that inserts a caret arrow in specified direction with configurable size, spacing, and alignment.
